name: get_score
description: The score or standing after the current moment (a scoreline, or positions and gaps in a race), with the period, lap or clock.

name: get_player
description: What one player or driver has done in this event so far, up to the current moment.

name.description: The player's or driver's name as given.

name: get_recent_play
description: The key moments just before the current one, oldest first.

name: get_player_profile
description: One player's record from earlier games this season or tournament (rates by zone, or batting by phase and bowling), blended with this event so far, with the counts behind each rate.

name: get_next_score_odds
description: Each team's likeliest next scorers so far, from their share of attempts and their scoring rate, before and during this event.
